gold_row.question: Liste alle Messwerte von Sensor 10.0 in Epoche 85 auf.
gold_row.gold_answer: mote_id=10 time=2004-02-28T01:40:16.985756 temperature=18.8124 humidity=40.6693 light=53.36 voltage=2.67532
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 10})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
MATCH (m)-[:EPOCH_IN]->(e:Epoch {epoch_id: 85})
WITH m, s
RETURN coalesce(s.mote_id, m.moteid, m.mote_id) AS mote_id, m.time AS time, m.temperature AS temperature, m.humidity AS humidity, m.light AS light, m.voltage AS voltage ORDER BY time, mote_id LIMIT 20
